lines.en: I drift in midair, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一扇，就滑出一段。
lines.en: One beat of my wings carries me along.
I slip beneath a branch.
My shadow slides over the bark.
I float up off the rotting leaves.
I circle through the dark of the black forest.
I bob up and down without landing.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴的缝里钻进去。
lines.en: I slip into a gap in the cave.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀发出很轻的响。
lines.en: My wings make a faint sound.
I skim over a patch of moss.
I stop in the air and hold still.
There's a small light in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从叶下滑出去，没有声音。
lines.en: I slip out from under the leaf without a sound.
I'm listening to water drip in the cave.
I spend the night on the back of a leaf.
My hands rest on my knees.
I'm not about to attack anyone.
I'm inside a pocket of quiet.
I tuck my face into my arms.
I listen to my own wings.
I'm not looking for trouble.
Your lamp bothers me.
There's nothing worth a fight here.
Step back, and I'll go.

lines.zh: 别抬头找我，我在你头顶。
lines.en: Don't bother looking up. I'm right above you.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，对吧？我也看见你了。
lines.en: You saw me, didn't you? I saw you too.

lines.zh: 林子这么暗，你偏要往上看。
lines.en: The woods are dark enough. Why look up?
I'm just circling you out of curiosity.
I spring a long way back.
I make a faint sound.
I wobble in midair.
This makes my flight unsteady.
My eyes have dimmed a little.

lines.zh: 我落在一根低枝上，黑森林还没黑透。
lines.en: I land on a low branch; the dark forest is not fully dark.
I shake and steady myself.
I'd still rather avoid a fight.
Put it on a leaf, not in the mud.
I won't touch that.
I'm only curious.

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是看你手里的光。
lines.en: I am not hungry — just watching the light in your hand.
I'll look from further off.
You hold it too high; I cannot reach.
I hover, then pounce low.
Something's wrong with that.
You knocked me into a spin.
One hop and I am on your shoulder.
I end up pressed by your shoulder.
You nearly swatted my wing.
I spring a long way back.

lines.zh: 我们靠得很近，我都不习惯。
lines.en: We're closer than I'm used to.
It took me a beat to steady.
My wing hit the wall.
You stepped back; so did I.
There's another small light in the dark.
Its eyes are dimmer than mine.
We land together, side by side.
In the dark forest I leap to strike.
We never make a sound.
There's a small tear in its wing.
We share the same patch of shadow.
At daylight, it was gone.

lines.zh: 我们在暗里并排，不出声。
lines.en: We hover side by side in the dark, silent.
I drift down and scoop it up.

lines.zh: 这粒东西，我两只手才捧住。
lines.en: It takes both my hands to cup this little thing.
I carry it back up to the tree.

lines.zh: 掉在苔上的我都看得见。
lines.en: I can see whatever falls on the moss.

lines.zh: 它从上面的洞里落下来。
lines.en: It fell from the hole above.
I hide it on the back of a leaf.
I dropped it down again.

lines.zh: 咦，这亮闪闪的东西归我了。
lines.en: Ooh, this shiny little thing is mine now.
You raised a hand, so I'll move.
My eyes have brightened.
It's different now.
No shouting; I just pounce.
Your hand is still raised.

lines.zh: 在这片暗里，我比你看得清。
lines.en: In this dark I see better than you.
I have decided.
You're too close to the tree.
One strike should do it.
You started this.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，藏在树影里。
lines.en: I crouch low and hide in the tree shadow.
Don't blink just yet.
Then let it start from this moment.
I follow above you.

lines.zh: 你抬手的方向我都记得。
lines.en: I remember which way you raised your hand.
I hop from tree to tree behind you.
You take a step; I drift a stretch.
Shadows are everywhere here.
You haven't moved again.
My wings never stop.
You're at the cave mouth.
Stone behind you, dark ahead.
You are trembling slightly.

lines.zh: 我一直绕在你的侧上方。
lines.en: I keep circling your upper flank.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在树间回响。
lines.en: Your breathing echoes between the trees.
I never come from the front.

lines.zh: 我等你把手放下那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment your hand drops.

lines.zh: 洞口只够一个人挤过去。
lines.en: The cave mouth fits one person.
I count your footsteps.
I swoop down and claw once.
My claws are small, and sharp.
Light, and very fast.
My teeth catch your sleeve.
You still haven't struck back.
That didn't land.
I loop once above you.
That's enough for me to stop.
I steady myself in the shadow.
You're still standing.
I settle back onto the branch.
There is a rush of air by your ear.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一扇，从树枝下钻过去。
lines.en: One beat of my wings and I slip under the branch.
You are knocked into a tree trunk.
I float out from behind a leaf.
One more small light in the dark.
The cave is very quiet.
There's still dew on my wings.

lines.zh: 我先是影子，然后才是眼睛。
lines.en: First a shadow, then eyes.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，找了处树荫。
lines.en: I circle once and find shade.
This darkness suits me.
I shake off the damp.
There's only a little light far off.

lines.zh: 我停在一个不会被打扰的位置。
lines.en: I settle where I won't be disturbed.

lines.zh: 火光照得我晕，我往后退。
lines.en: The firelight dazes me and I pull back.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，摔在腐叶上。
lines.en: I drop from the branch onto the rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 水裹住我的翅膀，我沉了。
lines.en: Water wraps my wings and I sink.
The blast throws me into a trunk.

lines.zh: 一颗东西穿过我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something passes through my wing.
Light sticks to me and I can't get free.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没吃什么了。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷光把林子照白了，我躲进洞。
lines.en: The flash whites out the wood; I hide in the cave.
No branches here, no shadows.
